why: The body designates every other player via ctx::target_all, but the CardDef sets no prop::DESIGNATES. In game-rules wasm_rules::designations() returns an empty Vec unless the card carries that prop, and the prop is also what opens the Effect-on-DESIGNATES play timing (CROSS-TESTS C13). So 通用:网络链接异常, though offered on its Card kind, reads an empty designation list and falls into its clause 2 「没有[指定]目标则抵消其所有的效果」 (full cancel) instead of clause 1 (cancel one designation); AG:宣战布告 is likewise not offered at the play window. (Nuance on the original claim: declare_war is not "never offered at all" -- it can still fire at the later `pay` effect window raised by ctx::transfer, i.e. after the demolition instead of as part of the play's own designation timing.) The twin card 通用:登上武道馆 sets exactly this prop for the same clause.
suggest: Add `.props(&[(card_sdk::abi::prop::DESIGNATES, 1)])` on the CardDef (as budokan does); the designation set is `world.others(user)`.

why: The sheet designates the four tiles, but the code only prompts with ask_tile (a pure option list) and never runs ctx::target_tile on the picks, so the designation never passes the targeting gate. target_tile checks the NO_TARGET mark before anything else (wasm_rules.rs:5699-5705) and refuses that tile; here a marked user-owned tile can still be picked, counted into X and demolished. The scenario is reachable: 高贵的微蓝 marks its user's own tile with NO_TARGET (「有标记时此地块不能被指定」), and cross-test T25 only covers a foreign owner, not the user's own marked tile. Cards that designate a tile (AG:ONE OF US:142, MyGO:Anon Tokyo:101, Mor:（toko）) call target_tile.

sheet_clause: 若为6则选择1-5中的3个效果触发
why: The book fixes no trigger order. ask_pick_multi answers a bitmask and decode_multi_mask walks bits lowest-first, so the player's pick order is lost and the three chosen effects always fire ascending (1 before 2 before ...). Order is observable: picking 2 and 3 fires 2 first, so the discard card placed on the deck top is the card then drawn; 3-then-2 would draw the old top instead. Only prose (module doc lines 11-13) states the reading; there is no TODO(规则书) at the loop, and docs/rulebook/spec/kani/ag.md:63 still lists multi-effect sequencing as OPEN.

why: Re-verified independently with a probe: take_card at line 56 removes the drawn copy from hand, then wasm_rules::to_discard -> world.to_discard (crates/game-core/src/engine/ops.rs:1042-1050) first removes *another* matching copy from the hand and only then pushes one card to the graveyard. sheet_clause: 选择[消耗]1到5次500资金
why: 「1到5次500资金」 is k separate 500 [消耗]s; spec C-AG-soul-01 spells it out (「k separate 500 [消耗]s (delete money, rulebook-doc.md:59), summed k*500」). The code collapses them into one `ctx::pay(500*n)`, so every per-payment hook fires once instead of k times: `Action::Pay` (yuri_crit on_pay rolls 1d20 per payment), `PayAfter` (nfo, hold_hands_again, sumimi, mumei_streamer), and each payment's [反击] Paid window. A second 赤红之魂 on the field with crystals is the sharpest case: per the print it could shave each 500 to 0, but with one summed payment its (1) gets a single offer. No TODO/BACKLOG item records the collapse (LOY-SOUL-01 only covers the 1..=5 cap).
suggest: Loop `ctx::pay(player_id, 500, ...)` n times (checking `player_out` between legs), then place the card and load the crystals.

why: Verified: `set_dest` only records the fate (wasm_rules.rs:1174-1177); the card enters the field at `place_card` on 94, i.e. after the ask (83-89) and the 消耗 (92). The book says 「…，然后选择…」 and spec C-AG-soul-01 lists placement as the first effect. The difference is observable: plays are allowed at 0 cash (money.rs:469), a shortfall runs `raise_funds`/`bankrupt` (play.rs:4057-4075), `bankrupt` clears the field (play.rs:4204, `remove_from_game`), and `place_card_on` only checks the player row (ops.rs:1214), so the soul lands on an already-out player's field. Cards like hold_hands_again (line 55) abort on `player_out` after `pay`; this body does not. No TODO/BACKLOG item records the inversion.
suggest: Place the instance first (`set_dest(Field)` + `place_card`), then `ask_number`/`pay`, then `set_crystals(n)`.
verify_note: Checked set_dest, place_card_on, pay/bankrupt/remove_from_game and the short-play test; order is really pay-before-place and the out-player consequence holds.

sheet_clause: 【反击】当你的一次掷骰小于6时，你可以打出此卡使结果+1
why: Verified end to end. A card-driven roll (ctx::roll, window=true) raises diceRollBefore with the face on `value` and no move payload (crates/game-rules/src/wasm_rules.rs:4012-4035 sets t.value = face, mv stays None), so bridge_trigger leaves `roll` None (wasm_rules.rs:7210-7220). cond_pre::move_roll returns -1/null for mv None or a negative face (crates/game-rules/src/cond_pre.rs:124-132), so `move.roll != null` is false and the card is never offered. Even if it were, counteract's `trigger::move_roll()` bail at line 39 returns Ok(()) without applying anything. The sheet's 「一次掷骰」 is not restricted to the move roll; docs/rulebook/spec/cards/ag.md:753-754 (C-AG-not-ok-01) rules 「『一次掷骰』 is any single die of the user, not only the move roll」 and marks the card `not-ok`. why: The clause keys off the whole [无法移动] gate, but this predicate reads only the `stay` field and the `stun` field. Two cases are missed: (a) a player holding a pending `stunStart` layer (stun::get reads only STUN, and hitoshizuku.rs:49-53 shows stunStart must be read separately) and (b) an [除外] player. Both are currently offered the move branch and get force-walked even though they cannot move; the book, the spec (C-MUJICA-人偶的箱庭-02 names [除外]/[晕眩]) and the status hosts all say they must pay. No TODO(规则书) at the site.

why: The fresh-MoveCtx gap is wider than direction. The card shapes only steps/resolve on the never-reset turn plan, so unrelated walk knobs left by earlier cards leak into both the victims' walk and the caster's forced move: a stale `stop_at` (迷宫仓库/春日/巡礼 set it and nothing clears it) truncates the garden's walk, and a stale `pay_factor`/`rent_factor` (祥，移动 500, 香澄 250) halves the caster's forced settle (scale_settle_payment reads turn.plan.pay_factor, play.rs:2503). C# `H.Walk(p, r, resolve:false)` / `H.CardMove(new MoveCtx{Steps=sum})` start from MoveCtx defaults (stop_at=None, pay_factor=1.0).

why: When everyone pays (or every roll resolves to 0) the body logs and returns before any `card_move`, so the forced sum walk never runs and `main_moved` is never set: the user keeps the turn's main move, although the book says the sum walk IS this turn's main move. It also leaves `resolve = false` on the shared turn plan (set at line 77), and both main_move (play.rs:1443-1445) and the moving card path (play.rs:913-915) only ever pull the clear direction, so a later main move in the same turn inherits `resolve = false` and walks without settling. Recorded as spec OPEN-箱庭0步, but no TODO at the site.
suggest: Always run a 0-step `card_move(player_id)` as the main move (resolve true) instead of returning early; keep the no-move log.

A normal play therefore moves nobody even when that same player countered you earlier this turn. Ran the scratch probe: normal play after a 宣战布告 counter gives `P1 before=10 after=10 prompts=0` and fails at zz_probe_look_away.rs:54. The spec test `look_away_only_moves_counteractors` passes only because its single case is the empty counterer set (verified: it passes in 4.95s), where no movement is expected either way. The TODO at 54-63 only describes the counteract path (trigger::player_id() = that link's declarer), so it does not cover this.
suggest: Branch per entry: on the play entry derive the target set from the turn's counteraction history and only skip when the set is empty; keep the guard only for the counter entry.

why: The plan's forced flag is never set, so card_move computes `as_main = is_turn && !plan.forced` (play.rs:789) and treats a forced walk of the turn player as that player's main move: if their main move is already spent the walk is silently refused (log.main_move_used, play.rs:791-800) and nothing settles. A counter-counter chain reaches exactly that case (P1 counters, P0 counters, P1 answers with this card: the victim is P0, the turn player). Reproduced: with the main move spent the victim stays put; with it unspent the same chain walks 0->2. Clause 02 makes only a self-chosen walk on the user's own turn a main move, so another player's forced walk should go through.
suggest: Expose/add plan::set_forced (or a not-a-main flag) and set it for the non-self case; keep the self-on-own-turn case on the main-move path per clause 02.

sheet_clause: 若使用者在自身回合内选择了使用者自己进行强制移动，则视为其主要移动
why: The only player ever walked is the immediate counterer. On the counteract entry the guard requires `actor != owner`, and on the play entry run() returns early (finding 1), so the owner can never appear as a mover and the self clause cannot occur. A self entry would only arise if the owner countered their own card earlier in the turn; the history that would carry it is the missing ABI-03 list. The consequence side is already right: card_move computes `as_main = is_turn && !plan.forced` (play.rs:789), so once the owner is in the set their own-turn walk consumes the main move.
suggest: Once the history exists, include the owner's self entry and walk it; card_move already applies the main-move bookkeeping.

The hook ignores the return and still writes the hit (and logs moved), so no hop happens and the card goes to the graveyard at the next turn start. Probe: play, land on an opponent tile, pay rent -> pos unchanged, keys [log.main_move_used, cards:card-crychic.fate_together_moved], card not in hand afterwards. The converse also diverges: a hop fired before the owner's main move counts as that main move and consumes it.
suggest: Run the hop as a non-main move (plan.forced / an engine effect-move path) and/or honour card_move's bool, keeping the card armed when the move is refused.
verify_note: Reproduced with a live probe; log keys show card_move refused via log.main_move_used while fate_together_moved is still emitted.
id: CRYCHIC:一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

sheet_clause: （2）若此卡打出后（1）效果未产生作用，将此卡返回手牌（不触发乐队技能的（3）效果）。
why: On a collection paid by another player the move is a host request, and the body is re-run from the already-moved position. If the next-in-order player owns no further tile strictly ahead of the landing tile (the ordinary case: they own only the tile just hopped onto), the re-run falls out of the loop before line 96, so the hit write from the first pass is dropped. `fate_hit` remains 0 and at the owner's next turn start the card wrongly returns to hand even though (1) moved the player. Probe zz_fate_hit_probe::probe_exact_one_copy (p1 owns only {5}): pos=5, fate_hit=0, card in hand at next start; control with p1 owning {5,8}: fate_hit=1, card graveyarded.
suggest: Store the hit on the card instance (`ctx::set_prop`) rather than the shared player slot and move the hit/log before `card_move`; pin the one-tile-ahead case in a test.
verify_note: Reproduced twice; contrast probe with a second tile keeps the hit, so the branch re-run is the trigger. BACKLOG STATE-INIT-01 recommends instance props for this kind of mem but only files the 0-init smell.
id: CRYCHIC:一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

sheet_clause:
若此卡打出后
（1）效果未产生作用，将此卡返回手牌（不触发乐队技能的
（3）效果）。
why: `SLOT_HIT` goes through `ctx::slot` -> `Ops::state_get(player_id, key)`, a free-form **per-player** counter (crates/game-core/src/engine/ops.rs:473-480), and `fate_together` resets it to 0 on every Play. The bit therefore answers "did any copy move since the last Play", not "did THIS instance move". Two copies share one bit and read the same value at the same instant, so they always take the same branch: if copy B is played after copy A hopped, the Play reset makes both copies return to hand at turn start -- the copy that did produce a result is wrongly returned instead of being discarded; if the hop lands after the second Play, both are discarded and the copy that never produced a result is wrongly discarded. (The reviewer's 'the copy that never hopped is discarded' half is backwards: with the shared 0 both copies return.)
suggest: Key the hit flag to the field instance (uid prop/counter) instead of the player slot, and write it before the move (see the separate replay finding).
verify_note: added by sweep verifier
id: CRYCHIC:一起演奏音乐的命运共同体

sheet_clause: 每当场上任意格子发生一次收款时
why: The cell arms the move on any collection on any tile; the guard narrows it to rent legs with value > 0. The narrowing is exactly the OPEN-收款 question in docs/rulebook/spec/cards/crychic.md but the file carries no TODO; header line 11 ('on every rent collection') repeats the narrowing unmarked.

sheet_clause: （3）每当你的手牌数从4增加至5，为此卡放置一个奇迹水晶（上限10）
why: Drawn is dispatched only to the drawn card itself and the field-card walk is skipped for it (wasm_rules.rs:4977-5004); the per-draw field point is Drew (as forever.rs uses). Because (3) is inert, the fate card's 「不触发（3）」 exemption is vacuous too (finding 2).
suggest: Register (3) on the field-card per-draw point (Action::Drew) plus the other hand-size-change points, not Drawn.

Because must=true also skips the PayKind::Build `exclude`, the chosen tile itself can be mortgaged by raise_funds and then gets a house while still mortgaged (play.rs:3736-3743, 4007-4031). G-SETTLE-07 (docs/rulebook/spec/FINDINGS.md:56) makes the build price the deed's marked house-building cost.
suggest: Pay through ctx::build_cost-aware build path (ctx::card_offer_build), or use ctx::pay_build plus the pct/discount/layer handling and a PayKind::Build payment; note pay_build returns 0 on a free build so the `> 0` gate must be adjusted.

why: The comment at 40-42 quotes `h.draw.InsertRange(0, h.discard)` and says the discard comes back underneath, but the loop inserts each card at deck index 0 while iterating oldest-first, so the graveyard order is inverted. suggest: Iterate in reverse (`for id in discard.iter().rev()`) or use one ordered insert so the newest discard stays directly under the deck.

sheet_clause: 使你的总移动数+2
why: Re-read the engine: the walk bound is `steps + m.extra_steps` re-read each iteration (play.rs:1702), and `fold_plan_delta` does copy `extra_steps` (play.rs:133-135) — but only after `moveBefore` (play.rs:1621) and in the teleport path (1860). The step loop's `passTile` raise (play.rs:1745) is followed only by the `stop_at` / `resolve` pulls (1763-1768), no fold, so a plan write made by this hook never reaches `m.extra_steps`. `set_extra_steps` assigns only `TurnCtx::plan.extra_steps` (ops.rs:67-69). why: In an On::Action hook the handler argument is the field-instance holder (wasm_rules.rs collect_hook_jobs / counteract_orig push Call::Hook{player_id: <field seat>}) while the triggering actor is trigger::player_id() (t.player_id). So the (3) redirect settle runs as the card's owner even when 「任何玩家」 else landed. Verified on a 2-seat table with the card bound to tile 10 and P1 landing there: the nested 弦卷集团 agent offer asked P0 (ASKED=[0]) and log.agent_skip carried seat 0, while P1 was the lander. With the agent tile owned this charges/offers the wrong player entirely. The (1) branch is unaffected because its counteract pre is `actor == owner`, so handler arg == settler there.
suggest: Settle the (3) redirect as `trigger::player_id()` (the settler); keep `player_id` only for the owner-side log.

sheet_clause: 当此卡位于格子上时，那格视为与“弦卷集团”格子交换位置
why: The clause swaps the square, not just its settle: while the card sits on it, that square IS 弦卷集团. Only the SettleBody (and TileResolved discard) are redirected, so [经过] effects do not swap: passing the card's square still runs the square's own pass rule, and passing 弦卷集团 runs none (the agent tile declares only On::Settle). A card on a tile with a pass reward therefore keeps paying it while treated as 弦卷集团. BACKLOG ABI-13 names this exact clause and this card as the consumer.
suggest: Add the PassTile half of the swap (or land ABI-13's tile-rule swap and drop the hand-rolled redirect).

sheet_clause: （2）获得x次经过CiRCLE时的资金奖励
why: The CiRCLE money half is paid through `ctx::gain_typed(mover, CIRCLE_MONEY, "pass", …)` (rules/tiles/src/circle.rs:238-243), so its money event carries the `pass` type. This body uses plain `ctx::gain`, which types the event as an ordinary `gain`; the `pass` attribution the sheet's 「经过CiRCLE时的资金奖励」 carries is lost in the event stream, and a listener keyed on pass-typed money would not see it (it does keep the `passRewardAffected` window, so the Morfonica rewrite still works).
suggest: Pay with `ctx::gain_typed(..., "pass", ...)` so the reward keeps the CiRCLE pass attribution.

suggest: Route the 100 through a no-modifier pay leg once the host exposes one, or leave an explicit TODO until then.

With rent_factor 500 an amount 500 settles as user 250 / payee 250 instead of 250/125 (or 500/250 if the factor should be locked out). Worse, the half is read from `trigger::value()` pre-scale, so charge_rent's `milli_scale` and the tile PAY_FACTOR never reach the half at all. The header comment names the C# `pay.kind = "lose"` but nothing changes kind and no TODO records it. Example path verified.
suggest: Drop the rent scale from the redirected leg (expose a lose/rent flag or use a non-rent kind) or derive the half from the post-scale figure; add TODO(规则书)（改为失去） either way.

The code binds `who` = the card user/payer and `to` = the payee, so the line renders the direction backwards and 「对方」 then names the payer instead of the seat that loses half.
suggest: Swap to .player_id("who", to) / .player_id("to", player_id), or swap the placeholders in both locale files.

sheet_clause: X为对方原本预计路径上你拥有的格子数
why: Verified: `tile_steps_ahead` (crates/game-core/src/engine/ops.rs:366-373) adds `steps` to the position with no direction factor, and the CEL pre's `on_path` (crates/cond/src/view_impl.rs:386-400) does `((pos + i) % n + n) % n` too, so both sites count strictly forward. The main move really can walk backwards: 美竹兰's 叛逆的红挑染 sets `plan::set_reverse(true)` in its DiceRollPlan window (`rules/skills/skill-personas/src/ran_red.rs:95`, i.e. before the dice), the walk loop steps by `m.dir()` = -1 when `reverse` (move_ctx.rs:284-290, play.rs:1704), and the positive roll still raises the diceRollResult window. On such a move the holder's deeds behind the mover are invisible to the pre (card never offered) and, if offered, X counts the wrong tiles. `tsugumi_plain.rs:113`, `this_hand.rs:43`, `rimi_choco.rs:69`, `cant_look_away.rs:94`, `saki_move.rs:60`, `anon_tokyo.rs:160`, `detour.rs:198` also reverse. No TODO at the site.
suggest: Walk `tile_steps_ahead(them, dir * i)` with the move/plan direction, and make the pre direction-aware instead of the forward-only `on_path` builtin.
verify_note: Confirmed. Note the pre's `on_path` is NOT the Rust helper: the pre string resolves to the baked cond-vocab accessor crates/cond/src/view_impl.rs:387, which is forward-only too ((pos + i) % n). A fix must change both that accessor and the body helper here. ctx::tile_steps_ahead (ops.rs:366) is pure forward geometry, and MoveCtx::dir/walk_dir (move_ctx.rs:285/294) exist.

why: A counteraction link carries no move payload: build_round builds each counter's CoreTrigger with `CoreTrigger::new("card"/"cardUsed", ...)` (crates/game-rules/src/wasm_rules.rs:6065) and bridges it with `bridge_trigger`, whose `mv` is `t.mv.as_ref().map(...)` and whose roll is only set for roll kinds (:7197-7223). Its body would also early-return at line 50. Repaint can only pile onto the root roll in the same lap, never answer a counter that has already cut it. The book's 「当任意其他玩家进行移动掷骰并进入移动阶段后」 is still true at that point. No TODO(规则书). (Verified with a probe test /tmp/rp.txt sequence and a temporary eprintln in bridge_trigger: every `kind=card` link printed mv=false.)
suggest: Have the card (or the bridge) fall back to the answered link's move face / plan roll so a counter-attached Repaint still has a roll to count.

Everything hangs on settle_after, which is only reached through a completed settle; apply_dest raises discarded on any real discard (wasm_rules.rs:5814-5816), and other placed cards already use Action::Discarded(card_sdk::pre::MINE, …) for exactly this 「此卡进入弃牌区」 trigger shape (guerrilla.rs:26, overlapping_voices.rs:34). Without the hook, a discarding effect on the placed card, the shortfall path and a cancelled settle all bypass the refund/cleanup.
suggest: Add On::Action(Action::Discarded(card_sdk::pre::MINE, None, on_discarded)) that refunds paid when no settle happened and clears the slots (guard against re-refunding settle_after's own discard).

why: Confirmed with one nuance. The only hook that discards the card is `SettleAfter` (entry at line 29) guarded by `SLOT_STOP`; no `On::Action(Action::Discarded/LeaveAfter ...)` exists on this card. So a placed copy that enters the discard without a settle (removed by another effect via `unplace_at`/`to_discard`, or the hand-shortfall path) is never refunded. The engine already raises `discarded` for both apply_dest (wasm_rules.rs:5820) and the counteract tail (6343), so the branch is implementable as a self-card Discarded hook (cf. guerrillas.rs:26). The shortfall branch is the one unsettled site that does have code, which is why this is not literally 'no code'.
suggest: Add an `Action::Discarded(pre::MINE, ...)` hook that refunds `paid` when `SLOT_STOP` is still 0, so every unsettled discard path is covered.

sheet_clause: 若此卡进入弃牌堆时结算获得的资金小于本卡原应拿到的资金或未结算则获得发动此卡消耗的资金
why: Confirmed against the engine: SettleStage::RaiseSettle goes straight to RaiseTileResolved when the settle is cancelled (play.rs:2105 `if self.out(i) || t.is_cancelled()`), and RaiseSettleAfter skips the raise when the payer is out/game over (play.rs:2135). settle_after is the only site that discards the card (line 180) and the only site that clears SLOT_STOP (line 175), so in both cases the card stays on the field with SLOT_STOP=1. Because settle_after has no tile/actor guard, the next ordinary settle at that tile then fires it: the card is discarded and the full rent (now unhalved) is compared to the halved expect, so nothing is refunded even though the forced stop was never settled. The clause ties the refund to entering the discard and to 未结算, not to a completed SettleAfter.
suggest: Handle the card entering the discard itself (Action::Discarded(MINE)) and/or clear SLOT_STOP when the forced stop's settle is cancelled or the payer is out; refund per 「未结算」.
verify_note: Engine skip points verified in play.rs:2105/2135; SLOT_STOP cleared only at 175; no tile guard in settle_after. Reviewer's chain is accurate.

sheet_clause: 使下一个经过且移动终点不在此各的你以外的玩家强制停下并触发结算
why: Confirmed and reproduced. SLOT_PAID/SLOT_GOT/SLOT_STOP are per-player, but two placed copies are legal (each copy is its own instance and field hook; ops.rs field_instances: "two copies of the same card are two hooks"). settle_after's only guard is the shared per-player SLOT_STOP; it never compares the running instance's tile with the settled tile (unlike pass_tile/pay_after). So on a forced settle of copy B, whichever copy sits earlier in placement order consumes the shared flag: it discards ITSELF (the wrong instance), computes expect from its OWN tile's rent (ctx::self_tile is the running instance), refunds against the shared SLOT_PAID (the later placement's cost), and copy B then returns early. Probe: copies on tile 1 and tile 7, P1 passes tile 7 -> after settle field tiles = [7], discard = [card]; correct result would be field tiles = [1] with no refund.
suggest: Make settle_after require trigger::tile() == self_tile() (and only then consume SLOT_STOP), or key the whole per-copy state (paid/got/stop) per placed instance instead of per player.

why: apply_view only SETS 500 on currently-raised tiles; it never clears RENT_FACTOR on a tile that has left the raised set. A raised tile built up to the max is no longer 「获得额外房屋数」 yet keeps charging half, and pay_after cannot repair it because it recomputes raised_tiles at pay time (a caught-up tile is excluded), so the factor survives the card's own discard. A raised tile sold to another player also keeps the half for a tile this effect never raised under the new owner. Neither TODO nor BACKLOG CRYSTAL-08 covers this (they name raze/sale staleness of the max and non-pay_after removal only).
suggest: Clear RENT_FACTOR to 0 on every owned non-RiNG tile (and on discard) before re-setting 500 only on the recomputed raised set.
verify_note: Ran the probes in this worktree: `cargo test -p ruleset-tests --test zz_rb_catchup_probe` fails both assertions — the caught-up tile paid 540 against a full 1080, and after the card's discard the factor is still 500 and it still pays 540. RENT_FACTOR is milli-units, 500 = ×0.5 (game-core play.rs:2469), and tile props are never reset on sale (purchase.rs:239 only reads). Class adjusted to extra_effect (a lingering effect beyond the qualifying set); the defect itself is confirmed.

sheet_clause: （2）你的所有格子上的房屋数视为与你房屋数最多的格子等同，但受此效果影响获得额外房屋数的格子收费减半
why: apply_view only writes 500 onto tiles that are below the max *right now*; it never writes 0 for a tile that leaves the raised set. The engine build writes houses[t] first and only then raises houseAdded (play.rs:3059), so a raised tile built up to the max (or past it) is absent from raised_tiles at the very apply_view that should have disarmed it and keeps RENT_FACTOR=500 permanently. pay_after's disarm (line 155) iterates the same raised_tiles, so it misses the stale tile too, and the prop is on the board-owned tile instance, so a later owner outside this card also charges half. The cell's RiNG parenthetical supports reading it as a charge, but TEST-FINDINGS §6.5 and COVERAGE still describe the Sweet Escape ruling as the tile *price* sum while this file (and the spec test) silently use the rent table. The card carries no `TODO(规则书)` pointing at the open term, so the rent-vs-price judgment is not visible at the site. If the price reading were right, both the guard and the gain would be wrong for every deed.
suggest: Add a `TODO(规则书)` at `price_tag` noting 收费标价 is OPEN and that we read it as the rent/charge (RiNG: base multiplier); reconcile the stale 'price sum' wording.

sheet_clause: 失去资金的总额即将超过你所在格子的[收费标价]
why: The clause is verbatim in the cell and the early return is real. `price_tag` yields 0 for exactly the 15 non-buyable board tiles (11 agent + CiRCLE + cafe + edogawa + ryuseido, all price 0 in data/board.json; the only buyable tiles with an empty rent table are the four RiNGs, which take the ring_multiplier branch). The cell puts no 'tile that has a 收费标价' qualifier on the tile, and with the code's own 0 model any positive loss already exceeds a 0 tag (and the C# comparison quoted in the TODO is true at Tag=0), so the card is silently unofferable there. Counter-evidence: spec/cards/sumimi.md:413 adds 'a tile that has a [收费标价]', and counteract itself skips the 0 gain, so the reading is at least self-consistent — low/medium stands. Not recorded in BACKLOG/TODO.
suggest: Drop the `tag <= 0` early return (the `tag > 0` test in counteract already skips a zero gain), or record it as a deliberate divergence.
verify_note: Verified the 15/60 zero-tag tiles and that the guard is exactly this return. The spec's 'tile that has a 收费标价' phrasing is the strongest counter-argument, but the sheet cell itself has no qualifier — keeps low/medium.

sheet_clause: [反击]当你或你的格子即将受到来自你以外的效果影响时打出此卡
why: The pre guard only tests whether a declared effect names the owner via effect.hits; the 「或你的格子」 half has no test. effect.hits compiles to chain_hits (targets only), and tile-only effects that never name the tile's owner (house removal etc.) yield no hit, so the card is not offered at all. The same 「你或你拥有的格子」 wording in AG:宣战布告 adds an explicit effect::tile + tile_owner residual loop (declare_war.rs:61-65).
suggest: Add the tile residual guard: any effect i with effect::tile(i) >= 0 && tile_owner(tile) == owner, like declare_war.rs:61-65.
verify_note: Cell says 「你或你的格子」; guard has no tile term; declare_war's parallel guard (same wording) does. No TODO records it.

sheet_clause: 当你或你的格子即将受到来自你以外的效果影响时打出此卡
why: The CEL `effect.hits(x)` rewrites to `chain_hits` (crates/cond/src/schema.rs:225), and `chain_hits` maps only each effect's `target` (crates/game-rules/src/wasm_rules.rs:7971-7977). Two cases the clause names are missed: (a) a payment that makes you the payer -- `ctx::pay` declares `to = -1` (crates/game-rules/src/hostfns.rs:545-548), and the Pay trigger stores target=-1, from=payer (crates/game-core/src/engine/play.rs:3379-3385), so `effect.hits(owner)` is false for the payer; e.g. against another player's `通用:CiRCLE THANKS PARTY!` 「所有其他玩家可选择[消耗]500资金」 (thanks_party.rs:51-53) 真奈 is never offered, though the payment hits her; (b) an effect that touches a tile you own without naming you -- declared as `tile`, not `target`. The guest helper `ctx::effect::hits` counts `from` as well (crates/card-sdk/src/ctx.rs:3281-3292), and declare_war.rs:48-51 adds a `ctx::tile_owner` loop; the CEL path has neither.
suggest: Gate with a guest `can_counteract` using `ctx::effect::hits(owner)` plus the tile-owner loop, as declare_war.rs does, instead of the target-only CEL predicate.
verify_note: Re-derived every hop: schema rewrite -> chain_hits(target only); hostfns pay to=-1; play.rs pay Effect{target: to.map_or(-1), from: payer}; thanks_party asks each other player to ctx::pay. The tile half also only has `tile`, never `target`. No TODO records this gate gap.

sheet_clause: [反击]当你或你的格子即将受到来自你以外的效果影响时打出此卡，此时场上其他玩家可如同自身的对应目标被指定一般打出[反击]卡
why: Half-confirmed, mechanism corrected. `by` in the Effect pre is `t.by_card` (cond_pre.rs:1328; -1 = none) and `p.by_card` is copied into the effect window at play.rs:3377 — but `pay_rent` builds its Pay without `by_card` (play.rs:2439-2452), so a plain rent settlement declares with by = -1 and `by >= 0` closes the window. Rent does open the `effect` chain (it is a money movement, play.rs:3369-3387), so this is a live miss on the most common 「来自你以外的效果」. Empirically verified with a probe: landing on another player's 购物中心 charged rent (money moved) but the card was never offered, while the same hand was offered under 通用:登上武道馆. The second half of the original claim is wrong: `effect.hits(owner)` DOES catch tile hits — `target_tile` stamps the tile's owner as the effect target (wasm_rules.rs:5717, 5742-5749), so 「你的格子」 through the targeting pipeline is covered. Only untargeted tile writes (house removal and friends) still miss, the same residual gap 宣战布告 documents for its identical 「你拥有的格子」 wording. No TODO/BACKLOG item records any of this (card-sumimi row lists only CH-05, LINGER-10, MONEY-08, DONUT-VOID-01).
suggest: Replace `by >= 0` with a source test that admits board rent without admitting your own board payments: `by != owner && (by >= 0 || pay_is_rent)` (dropping `by >= 0` outright would also offer the card on your own bank purchase, whose Pay has from = you and by = -1).
verify_note: Confirmed the rent half by reading play.rs:2439-2452 vs 3369-3387 and by running a probe (rent charged, no offer; card effect does offer). Refuted the hits/tile half: target_tile sets effect.target = tile owner (wasm_rules.rs:5743-5749), so targeted tile effects hit. Line 24 and the clause quote are exact. No TODO at the site.

sheet_clause: 此时场上其他玩家可如同自身的对应目标被指定一般打出[反击]卡，且其反击卡中针对打出玩家自身的效果改为你。
why: The join/redirect is supposed to exist only while THIS card is played, but wasm_rules.rs:5963-5977 pre-scans every hand for any SELF_REDIRECT card and stamps `chain[0].link.join_redirect = Some(seat)` before any body runs, with no check that the card is ever declared and no clearing when it is not. A 真奈 merely sitting in a hand therefore arms the whole window: another player's [反击] with a self-targeted clause gets redirected to the holder and draws them. Probe: with 真奈 in P1's hand but never played, P2's 通用:网络链接异常 redirected its self-cancel and P2 drew (hand 1->1, deck 20->19); control without the card in hand: hand 1->0, deck 20->20. The pre-scan also takes the lowest seat with a copy, so with two copies the wrong holder can be armed even when the other one declares later.
suggest: Arm `join_redirect` only when the SELF_REDIRECT counter is actually declared (clear the pre-scan value after the build round if the opener never lands).
verify_note: added by sweep verifier

sheet_clause: （1）此卡所在格子的[结算]改为回合结束后获得一层[停留]。
why: Once a settle has been replaced, the turn-end 停留 is owed. The layer is stored off-card (per-player slot `parking_space_stay`), but the deferred grant only happens in the card's own TurnEndAfter body. If the card leaves play before that turn end, the layer sits in the slot and is never paid (only a later copy's settle would flush it). The real mechanism is broader than the shared guard: field hooks are only dispatched for cards still on the field (wasm_rules.rs:5020 iterates world.field_instances), so removing is_placed from the guard alone would NOT fix it; the defer makes the grant depend on the card still existing. Nothing records this.
